verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents agent-driven provisioning: claiming new sandboxes from templates or snapshots, including in parallel. Agents can execute code through REPL or Cmd contexts in an isolated cloud computer and read results via process contexts and the files API. Its use as the sandbox backend for the OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain Deep Agents, plus a non-interactive `s0` CLI, supports fully programmatic runs with no human involved. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a delete/teardown API (only pause is evidenced), detail on how execution output is returned to the agent, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
